ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'CDN.ESKLEP_EksportAtrybutyObiekty') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) drop procedure CDN.ESKLEP_EksportAtrybutyObiekty

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.ESKLEP_EksportAtrybutyObiekty @ID INT -- ID e-sklepu ,@TypExp INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS
SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @Typ_AtrybutKlasa SMALLINT = 14416 DECLARE @PcKTSSynchr INT
SELECT @PcKTSSynchr = PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw FROM cdn.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_PicoID = @ID
SELECT CASE WHEN CDN.AtrTyp2GIDTyp(Ato_GIDTyp) = 960 AND ATO_Element = 1 THEN 2 WHEN CDN.AtrTyp2GIDTyp(Ato_GIDTyp) = 960 AND ATO_Element = 0 THEN 1 WHEN Ato_GIDTyp = 16 THEN 3 WHEN Ato_GIDTyp = 32 THEN 4 END AS Typ,AtK_ID AS AtrDefID,AtK_Wymagany AS Obowiazkowy,AtO_Lp AS LP,(CASE WHEN AtK_Typ IN (1,4) THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS Edycja FROM CDN.AtrybutyKlasy AS OATR JOIN CDN.AtrybutyObiekty ON AtO_AtKId = AtK_ID AND AtO_GIDTyp IN (9472,16,32) AND AtO_Element = 0 WHERE AtK_eSklep = 1 AND AtK_CzasModyfikacji >= CASE WHEN @TypExp = 0 THEN @PcKTSSynchr ELSE 0 END FOR XML RAW ('OATR')
SET NOCOUNT OFF
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ESKLEP_EksportAtrybutyObiekty TO CDNRaport
